children: will offer initial public offering allocations to U.S. retail traders, starting with Oura's
IPO this week, the company said Monday.

The move is another step in Coinbase's aim to become the "Everything Exchange." Customers can request an IPO allocation on its new IPO page in the Coinbase app by selecting a stock on the active deal page. After the user funds their account to cover the cost of the requested shares, they can submit a "conditional offer to buy" once the expected price range is disclosed.

When the IPO's order book is closed, available shares are allocated and booked directly into the customer's account at the IPO price. Depending on underwriter supply and total customer demand, requests may be filled in full, in part, or not at all.

allocation algorithm "prioritizes investors who believe in what they’re purchasing for the long haul," the company said. A customer who sells their IPO shares in the first 30 days may risk being barred from IPO participation for the following 60 days. They may also get smaller and less frequent allocations if they repeat such behavior, compared with investors who hold their IPO shares for longer periods.
